message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: "2012年到2014年间，被告人许某利用担任中原银行新乡分行（原新乡银行）卫北支行行长的职务便利，逢年过节分五次收受河南中原重工制造有限公司总经理葛某现金共5万元，为其在贷款业务方面提供帮助。"

This is classic "受贿" (accepting bribes). The act: using position to accept money in exchange for providing help in loan business. So the crime is "受贿". Possibly also "行贿" is for the other party, but we only list crimes of the defendant. So "受贿". Under Chinese criminal law, "受贿罪". So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "滥用职权" but that's not a crime per se; "职务侵占" not applicable. So just "受贿". Provide format.
